privacy.method: Live serialization audit. Synthetic RFC 2606 PII was pushed through the REAL production serializers and the emitted bytes inspected. Not a keyword grep.

findings.title: Prose-embedded PII reaches the provider through the new semantic-facts channel
findings.status: PROVEN, UNFIXED — blocks committing the semantic-observation work
findings.preExistingComponent: The world model already held this text, but the world model is NEVER egressed, so no provider exposure existed before this channel.
findings.rootCause: rawValueScanner applies ANCHORED whole-value shapes (isValidPAN = /^[A-Z]{5}[0-9]{4}[A-Z]$/, BARE_DIGIT_RUN = /^[\d\s-]{9,}$/, isValidLuhn on 13-19 digits). PII embedded in prose does not match any anchored shape, so the re-screen passes it. Measured: '<PAN>' -> [pan] but 'PAN <PAN> on file' -> []. '1234567890' -> [account_number] but 'Account number <10-DIGITS>' -> [].
findings.proof: scratch/p1_proof.test.ts — the literal strings appear in JSON.stringify(minimizeAgentContext(...).payload), the exact object POSTed to the provider.
findings.whyNotCaughtEarlier: The G5 test proved facts are a strict SUBSET of world-model text, which is true. It did not establish that the subset is itself PII-free in prose.
exactRemediationRequired: 1. Add a PROSE-EMBEDDED scan to the fact re-screen in extension/src/semanticObservation/factExtraction.ts screenFact(): apply each sensitive shape to SUBSTRINGS of the candidate, not the whole string (PAN / Luhn / labelled account / labelled OTP / address).
2. Reuse the existing F-09 person-name heuristic shape rather than inventing a new name rule, and apply it to fact displayText; drop the fact on a match.

3. Prefer a WORD-LEVEL extraction (label + adjacent value) so the fact carries 'Price: 24' and not the whole surrounding paragraph, which reduces the exposed surface structurally rather than only by filtering.
4. Add a regression test that asserts no fact's displayText or displayValue matches any prose-embedded PII shape, and that the minimized payload contains none.
5. Re-run the real-reasoner PROVEN_REAL run afterwards; the multi-step proof depends on this channel.
findings.notDoneBecause: The audit instruction is to prove a P0/P1 and report the exact remediation rather than silently make a large architectural change. Options 1-3 are a design decision for the maintainer.
findings.blastRadiusIfUnfixed: No released exposure: the work is uncommitted. Committing it as-is would introduce the first provider-visible free-text PII path in the product.
